::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 13th 1896  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.
:::

My dear [Mr Moor](people/person_1046.qmd)
Mr Reynolds has just been here about [Annie Norgate](people/person_917.qmd).[^1] I shall be most thankful to you for helping her, and shall gladly join in the £10.10 subscription for her

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

Mr Davies writes to[^2]

---

[^1]: Anne Norgate (1876-1896), was blind.  Her death was registered in the last quarter of 1896.
[^2]: The letter breaks off thus.
